goal: Allow non-standard scripts into the mempool on testnets when -acceptnonstdtxn=1 is set
Lets developers testing experimental scripts or soft forks relay transactions instead of mining them directly
agreement: Tested ACK verifying compiler enforcement and debug build checks against a rebased branch (instagibbs)
Code review approval after documentation and compile-time check discussions settled (fjahr)
Contested objection that enabling upgradable opcodes exceeds original Knots flag behavior (luke-jr)
Open questions on Assume vs assert usage and release note phrasing (instagibbs)

categories.name: mempool
why: P3 because it lets developers relay transactions with experimental scripts or soft forks on test networks
Transactions using opcodes like OP_SUCCESS or OP_NOPx can be tested in mempools without direct block mining
